discovery_notes: Cell B100, follow-up 1 of B022 (DS 2017). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Resolved Storybook Classics #7/#10/#12 and keyed live-action BatB set as 2017 (Chip & Co Jan 2017). New: DS UK Aladdin 25th LE 500, D23 DS Marvel set, many DSSH 2017 monthly, surprise, PTD and Villain event releases. Kept holds: 30th week split + Week 8, Coco 3 of 8, Last Jedi 2/3, Park Pack Oct. Resellers (yourwdwstore, others) seen, not used.
